logistic.description: Sigmoid logistic curve centered at median (par=50.0). Smooth non-linear saturation.
logistic.rationale: Prevents arbitrary hard clipping; preserves distinction between elite (85+) and legendary (95+) knocks.

robust.description: Median and IQR linear expansion clipped at [0, 100].
robust.rationale: Clips 4.2% of extreme knocks hard at 0 or 100.

min_max.rationale: Highly distorted by historic multi-sigma outliers (e.g. 175* off 66 balls).

percentile.rationale: Forces uniform distribution, flattening clustering around par.
